methodologyNote: Measured via page views with full browser version detail.
metricLabel: market share of tracked page views / usage
aiSummary: In October 2026, Chrome for Android led browser versions (mobile) in Kenya at 62.38% (market share of tracked page views / usage). Opera 99.6 ranked second at 13.67%, followed by Opera 99.7 at 4.17%.

faqs.question: Which item leads browser versions (mobile) in Kenya?
faqs.answer: Chrome for Android leads at 62.38% in October 2026 (market share of tracked page views / usage). Source: https://gs.statcounter.com/browser-version-market-share/mobile/kenya.

faqs.question: What does the market share of tracked page views / usage metric mean?
faqs.answer: Figures are market share of tracked page views / usage from the cited source for October 2026. They are not invented estimates.

faqs.question: What are the top three for browser versions (mobile) in Kenya?
faqs.answer: Chrome for Android (62.38%), Opera 99.6 (13.67%), Opera 99.7 (4.17%) in October 2026.
